name: Tsukamoto Yuugo
source:
Father of [url=/c13500]Shio[/url]. The two were separated due to a huge fight between them (It seems that he had Shio cast out from his house).

[spoiler]In Memo Off 6 - Next Relation:
Yuugo have reconciled with Shio, and is now free to show off his great love to [url=/c13562]Kaori[/url].
In addition, it turns out he is a merry drinker.[/spoiler]
